title: Raising Arizona
tagline: Huggies, and whatever cash you got.
about: An ex-con and an ex-cop who can't have a baby take one of furniture king Nathan Arizona's quintuplets, and everyone in Arizona comes after him.
cue: Fire up the chimichangas when Hi robs the store for Huggies.
faces: "I'll be taking these Huggies and whatever cash you got."
No fowl? Then we ate crawdad. Spiced yabbies, corn and potatoes, lemon butter.
Funny shapes? Not unless round is funny. Crumbed cheddar and jalapeno balls, ranch dip.
Nathan Arizona was born Huffheinz. Crisp fried beef burritos, salsa, sour cream.
He left a scorched earth in his wake. Charred chipotle chicken, street corn, lime.
Want a Dunkin' Donuts? Call a cop. Hot cinnamon sugar doughnuts, caramel dip.
Nathan Arizona's lawmen drink plenty of it.

    SnacksMoses' yabby and corn boilNo fowl? Then we ate crawdad. Spiced yabbies, corn and potatoes, lemon butter.How to make it1kg cooked yabbies or crawfish, in the shell500g baby potatoes2 corn cobs, cut in thirds3 tbsp Cajun seasoning2 lemons4 garlic cloves, smashed80g butter2 tbsp chopped parsleyBring a big pot of water to the boil with the seasoning, half a lemon and the garlic.Boil the potatoes until nearly tender, then add the corn for 5 minutes.Add the yabbies just to heat through, then drain.Melt the butter with the remaining lemon juice and parsley, pour over and tip it all out on the table.Evelle's round jalapeno cheese ballsFunny shapes? Not unless round is funny. Crumbed cheddar and jalapeno balls, ranch dip.How to make it250g cream cheese, softened200g sharp cheddar, grated3 tbsp pickled jalapenos, chopped75g plain flour2 eggs120g panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil, for frying150ml ranch dressingMix the cream cheese, cheddar and jalapenos and roll into 20 balls, then chill until firm.Roll in flour, then egg, then panko.Fry at 180°C in batches until golden.Drain and serve with ranch.Beef jerky by the registerGrab it before Hi grabs the till.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot FoodUnpainted Arizona beef chimichangasNathan Arizona was born Huffheinz. Crisp fried beef burritos, salsa, sour cream.How to make it1kg beef chuck, in big chunks1 brown onion, sliced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp chipotle chilli powder400g tin crushed tomatoes8 large flour tortillas150g Monterey Jack or cheddar, grated500ml vegetable oil, for frying250g tomato salsa150g sour creamBrown the beef in a heavy pot, add the onion, garlic, spices and tomatoes and a cup of water.Cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart, then shred it in the sauce.Spoon beef and cheese onto each tortilla, fold in the sides and roll up tight.Shallow-fry seam side down first, turning, until crisp and golden.Serve with salsa and sour cream.Lone Biker's scorched-earth chickenHe left a scorched earth in his wake. Charred chipotle chicken, street corn, lime.How to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, chopped3 limes2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp olive oil4 corn cobs3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise60g feta, finely crumbled1 tsp chilli powder1/2 cup coriander leavesMix the chipotle, juice of a lime, garlic, oil and salt and coat the chicken.Grill the corn over high heat, turning, until charred all over.Grill the chicken over high heat until blackened in spots and cooked through, then rest.Brush the corn with mayo, roll in feta and dust with chilli.Slice the chicken, scatter with coriander and serve with the corn and lime wedges.SweetsCall-a-cop cinnamon doughnutsWant a Dunkin' Donuts? Call a cop. Hot cinnamon sugar doughnuts, caramel dip.How to make it350g plain flour7g sachet dried yeast50g caster sugar, plus 100g for rolling180ml warm milk1 egg40g soft butter2 tsp ground cinnamon1 L vegetable oil, for frying200g dulce de lecheMix the flour, yeast, 50g sugar, milk, egg and butter into a soft dough and knead until smooth.Cover and leave until doubled.Roll out 1.5cm thick, cut rings and leave to puff for 20 minutes.Fry at 175°C, a minute or so a side, until golden.Toss in the cinnamon sugar and serve with warmed dulce de leche.Cold DrinksDesert trailer prickly pear margaritaHi and Ed's trailer out in the desert. Tequila, lime and prickly pear, salted rim.How to make it180ml tequila90ml orange liqueur120ml prickly pear syrup4 limes2 tbsp sea salt flakes2 cups ice cubesRub the glass rims with lime and dip in salt.Shake the tequila, liqueur, syrup and lime juice hard with ice.Strain over fresh ice.Coffee in a foam cupNathan Arizona's lawmen drink plenty of it.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
